faq.title: Got questions?
faq.intro: Short answers, before your first demo.

what.a: An Instagram Live screen simulator you open on your phone. You pick the audience, the comment language and the duration, then start the demo. It is free and there is no account to create.

real.q: Does it start a real live on Instagram?
real.a: No. LiveLayer is an independent project, not affiliated with Instagram or Meta. The screen is a simulation: nothing is published, no account is linked and nobody gets a notification.

exit.q: How do I leave the live in the middle of a demo?
exit.a: The X at the top right asks for confirmation, then shows the end screen. To leave instantly, with no end screen, triple-tap the host name at the top left: your demo stays clean to the very end.

data.q: Where do my data and my camera go?
data.a: Nowhere. Everything stays on your device, camera included: nothing is sent anywhere else. The front camera is optional, you turn it on only if you want your face in the background.

iphone.q: How do I get it fullscreen on iPhone?
iphone.a: Open LiveLayer in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". Launch it from its icon afterwards: it opens in true fullscreen, with no address bar.

footer.disclaimer: Independent project, not affiliated with Instagram or Meta. The screen is a simulation made for demos and practice. Nothing leaves your device.
